Ebb 9/20/2025 5:11 AM
Ok after a long and rough and EXTENSIVE taste test
5:11 AM
I have created the objectively correct list
Ebb 9/20/2025 5:32 AM
Starting from worst to best tasting 10 Umbrella: FUCK THIS ONE ALL MY HOMIES HATE UMBRELLAS. The flavor is NOT worth the pain I have to go through here ... It tastes so mid and the only way to get the full experience requires my jaw to be dislocated in violent ways? Wtf! 9 Sand: ill admit, I was a sand eater as a kid... But it's for that reason I have to put sand so low. Probably my most bias low pick, I can't really justify myself to put it higher considered sand related trauma.... (Joke) 8 Coke bottle clear vinyl: I had to look this one up tbh... And I can't say im impressed. They say a meal's presentation is half the taste and it is TRUE for this case. Why go for that when you can have a nice black.... So aesthetic... So vintage... Way cooler than this prison game controller looking vinyl (im sure the audio is a different quality but aesthetics are important!) 7 Pineapple on pizza: now we're getting into the mid territory. From here in out it's not bad, just okay. I won't hate on this one TBH the hate here is overdone HOWEVER I don't really like it that much. THE REAL pizza combo is Pepperoni Green chili Extra cheese That's the REAL pizza topping combo.... Yum yum 6 Brick: it's a hit or miss for me. It depends on the brick! Like for instance.... Does it have the sauce (concrete)? How long has it been on the wall? How has erosion been treating the outer layer? Ugh theres so many variables that it's soo unreliable! It'd be higher if I could expect more from it. Personally I don't like to play Russian roulette with my food unless I specifically want to 5 At least 47 coins: honestly it's specifically the fact it's AT LEAST 47 coins. Personally this would be higher if it was at the least 11. I've always been more of a quality over quantity guy, so 11 coins is sooo much better! 47 is just too much. Though I won't deny that when the craving is big enough, you won't see me complaining about more coins ;) 4 Asbestos: NOW WERE GETTING INTO THE GOOD STUFF. I mean, abestos is a classic! Who could forget their first time eating that spicy cotton candy! From the flavor to the texture, it's just generally good! I can't put it higher but I think this is definitely the STAPLE for just good flavor. Though, id prefer it if they made it look more appetizing 3 Dicys house keys: honestly dicy you need to upgrade your keys more often, you always get the same ones! Other than that OH MY GOOOIID I can't get enough sometimes. Sometimes I'll just sneak in dicys house just to gnaw on those wonderful things. Just.... Don't worry about the suspiciously key shaped bulge in my stomach when you're missing your keys ... 2 Bisexualism: I honestly had a hard time picking this or the other one for the number one spot, but I decided on this being number two given that bi means two! Very good flavor! I love having all of the options presented to me! Truly a majestic flavor and if anyone disagrees with me I will be mildly suspicious of your political leanings! AND FINALLY NUMBER ONE! 1 The rise and fall of a Midwest princess: YOURE TELLING ME I GET A BANGER FLAVOR AND A MOVIE?! Truly magnificent....the plots of political drama will always be entertaining... Though the endings are usually a little tragic, I can't help but admire the effort put into them! Plus, bonus points if the princess is bi, which is another reason this is number one and bisexualism is number 2 I hope you enjoyed my list discord user mudkip_ig and anyone else who was dying to know
